en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a town square with two early 20th-century buses, cobblestone streets with tram tracks, several people standing near the center, well-maintained trees and shrubbery, and multi-story European buildings. A prominent monument or memorial (possibly a war memorial) is visible near the center-left. There is printed text at the bottom in a cursive script.
